executions.root_cause: New upstream reference projection reopened a database UoW from cursor.connection.info.dsn. The driver omits the password, so the reopened pool could not authenticate.
executions.fix: Extracted existing exact reference validation into a cursor helper. Public database-url callers open one UoW; outcome projection reuses its existing authenticated cursor for label, subject and adjudication reads. No DSN exposure or PGPASSWORD workaround.
executions.regression: The existing real PostgreSQL test now forbids new reference UoW construction during outcome projection and retains all independent-author, exact-lineage, subjective-reference and no-domain-qualification assertions.

Upstream monetary allocation/campaign validators and campaign scope/entitlement/limits/settlement function ASTs compared unchanged.
Paired v5 schema and definition 1.5.0 validated; published v4 schema rejects paired policy.
Automatic creative_budget_scope PRODUCTION permission and cost_routing reference metric retain native behavior; new Actor and longform stages remain present.

The PostgreSQL suite covers paired cumulative ledger, immutable scope, unknown usage, retries, source permission, single-book reallocation, mixed USD and entitlement settlement, price expiry, native reference evaluation, and campaign receipt-loss recovery.
